notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with defender.
description:
Activate Overgrown Battlement by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Arcanis's first ability by tapping it, causing you to draw three cards.
Tolarian Kraken triggers three times. Resolve the first two triggers, causing you to pay {2} to untap Arcanis and Overgrown Battlement.
Resolve the last Tolarian Kraken trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.
